关键输入: - Linear MCP server must be connected and accessible via OAuth - Confirm access to the relevant Linear workspace, teams, and projects
关键输出: 过程辅助，无固定交付物
解决具体问题: 当需要- Authentication: Clear browser cookies, re-run OAuth, verify workspace permissions, ensure API access is enabled. - Tool Calling Errors: Confirm the model supports multiple tool calls, provide all required fields, and…时，用它完成对应判断、生成或操作流程。
